title: rehmannia glutinosa var. purpurea
intro: Rehmannia glutinosa var. purpurea, commonly known as Chinese foxglove or purple rehmannia, is a perennial plant native to China, belonging to the gentian family (Gentianaceae). The plant is valued for its adaptogenic properties and has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to promote longevity and improve overall health. The health benefits of Rehmannia glutinosa var. purpurea include its ability to nourish the yin, calm the mind, and enhance physical and mental well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, polysaccharides, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating effects.
